reviews.title: Great price, pretty good quality.
reviews.comment: I have a Ryzen 7 7800X3D to slay demons and impress all my friends, this cools it very nicely Installs like any other AIO.
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.title: Very effective
reviews.comment: Okay I don’t know if it’s my fans or the AIO fans, but the noise isn’t that loud. The ARGB is pretty bright and I love the design on the block. It makes my pc look custom and really mine. It looks different. It cools my i7 pretty well and it already comes with it assembled so all you have to do is put the block on and tighten the screws. 10/10
reviews.author: David Medina

reviews.title: Wayyy better than air cooler
reviews.comment: I had a cheap master air cooler that blows down, it starts leaking weird yellow substances on the fan so I went ahead and got this AIO; Works wonderful, way cooler than the air cooler, and not to mention it's quieter too under full load 75c and idle at 40c. The daisy chain argb is beautiful too. Not to mention the crazy price here what a steal!
reviews.author: llyod

reviews.title: Great budget AIO cooler
reviews.comment: Paired with a Ryzen 7600x, temps never above 70 degrees celcius, not too noisey once the air is bled. Great value for money.
reviews.author: javierjjasso

reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.comment: In real usage it works great. On stress test my cpu runs VERY hot(7700x amd) thats why i bought this, it still maxed out at 95C, but im overclocked. Its put in my system slightly crooked because my ram and case wont let it but straight
reviews.author: Braidon N.
